fields.climate: temperate in north with mild, rainy winters and hot, dry summers; desert in south
fields.terrain: mountains in north; hot, dry central plain; semiarid south merges into the Sahara
fields.resources: petroleum, phosphates, iron ore, lead, zinc, salt
fields.farm: milk, tomatoes, olives, onions, chillies/peppers, watermelons, potatoes, wheat, dates, oranges
fields.exports: garments, insulated wire, olive oil, refined petroleum, crude petroleum
fields.industries: petroleum, mining (particularly phosphate, iron ore), tourism, textiles, footwear, agribusiness, beverages
fields.languages: Arabic (official, one of the languages of commerce), French (commerce), Tamazight
fields.religions: Muslim (official; Sunni) 99%, other (includes Christian, Jewish, Shia Muslim, and Baha'i) <1%
fields.legal: mixed system of civil law, based on the French civil code and Islamic (sharia) law; Supreme Court reviews some legislative acts in joint session
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal except for active government security forces (including the police and the military), people with mental…
fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary service for men and women; men 20-35 years of age subject to 12 months of compulsory national service
